answer:
The Filipino statesman who established the government-in-exile during the outbreak of World War II was **Manuel L. Quezon**. 

He served as the **acting mayor of Quezon City** (which at that time was still called **Balintawak**) from October 12 to November 4, 1939. This area was later renamed in his honor and officially chartered as Quezon City in 1939-1940.
